# NavMenuMode

`Flare.Components.NavMenuMode`

How a FlareNavMenu presents its items. Set it explicitly to control the menu independently of any surrounding FlareLayout; leave it unset to keep the legacy behavior (driven by Rail or the collapsed layout drawer).

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Full` | `0` | The full menu: labels, group titles, expand chevrons and badges are all shown. |
| `Rail` | `1` | Mini-rail: every item is trimmed to its icon only -- link/group text, the group expand chevron and link badges are hidden and the icons are centered. |
| `RailLabeled` | `2` | Labeled rail: each item shows its icon with a small caption stacked underneath instead of hiding the text. Wider than Rail but self-describing. |

## Used by components

- `FlareNavMenu`
